Jansno X80 MAX UL 2849/ EN15194 Certified Moped Style Off-Road Electric Bike Fat Tire and Carries TWO People for Commuting

Jansno X80 MAX is a high-performance all-terrain off-road electric bicycle built to handle daily city commutes and rugged cross-country trails with equal ease. Upgraded with an extended elongated seat to comfortably fit two riders, this powerful e-bike supports optional rear racks and storage trunks for hassle-free cargo hauling during trips or outdoor excursions.

Core Key Features

Dual 1000W Hub Motors

Front and rear wheels each come equipped with a 1000W brushless motor, delivering a combined peak output of 2000W. Experience blistering fast acceleration and immense torque to climb steep slopes and power through tough terrain effortlessly.

Long-Range Dual Battery Options: 48V 17Ah + 48V 20Ah

Fitted with large-capacity removable lithium batteries for flexible long-distance rides. Reach up to 70 km on full electric mode, or travel as far as 100 km with pedal assist on a single full charge.

All-Terrain 20×4.0 Fat Tires

Wide thick shock-absorbing fat tires deliver unmatched traction and stability. Conquer rough gravel roads, muddy trails, snow-covered paths and soft sand without slipping or bumpy rides.

Hydraulic Disc Brakes

High-performance hydraulic braking system offers instant, consistent and reliable stopping power in rain, snow or dry weather for maximum riding safety.

Dual Suspension System

Front and rear shock absorbers smooth out every bump and uneven surface, guaranteeing ultra-comfortable rides even on the roughest off-road landscapes.

Smart LCD Digital Display

Intuitive dashboard screen tracks real-time riding metrics including current speed, remaining battery life, trip distance and pedal assist levels, letting you monitor all vital ride data at a glance.

Heavy-Duty High Load Capacity

Engineered to support a maximum total weight of 120 kg (265lbs). Its outstanding load-bearing design makes it ideal for two passengers, luggage, camping gear and daily cargo transport.

The all-new 2026 Jansno X80 MAX redefines entry-level powerful e-bikes and outperforms every low-budget electric bike on the market.
It stands out as the most cost-effective two-seater off-road e-bike available, packing brutal power, premium durable build quality and sleek refined design at an unbeatable price point.
